sourceTitle: Cell-free protein synthesis for next-generation biomanufacturing.
sourceAbstract: Chemicals with diverse molecular structures are essential to the pharmaceutical, food, and specialty chemical industries; however, their sustainable production remains challenging due to complex cellular regulation, limited metabolic flexibility, and the scalability constraints of purified enzyme-based systems. Extract-based cell-free protein synthesis (CFPS) has emerged as a versatile biomanufacturing platform that enables the production of functional enzymes in vitro and provides an open, programmable environment for constructing synthetic biosynthetic systems beyond the constraints of living cells. By decoupling chemical synthesis from cellular growth, CFPS allows precise control over enzyme composition, pathway stoichiometry, and cofactor utilization, thereby improving catalytic efficiency and resource utilization. In this review, we summarize recent advances in extract-based CFPS for chemical biosynthesis and discuss key engineering strategies, including cofactor regeneration, pathway balancing, and semicontinuous operation, to enhance system performance. Furthermore, we highlight emerging opportunities to integrate CFPS with artificial intelligence-guided design, renewable feedstocks, and modular reactor technologies toward more sustainable and scalable biomanufacturing processes.
titleZh: 用于下一代生物制造的无细胞蛋白合成
abstractZh: 结构多样的化学品对制药、食品和特种化学品行业至关重要；然而，由于细胞调控复杂、代谢灵活性有限，以及基于纯化酶的体系存在规模化限制，其可持续生产仍面临挑战。基于细胞提取物的无细胞蛋白合成（CFPS）已成为一种用途广泛的生物制造平台，既可在体外生产具有功能的酶，也能为构建突破活细胞约束的人工生物合成体系提供开放、可编程的环境。通过将化学合成与细胞生长解耦，CFPS能够精确控制酶的组成、途径化学计量关系和辅因子利用，从而提高催化效率和资源利用率。本综述总结了基于细胞提取物的CFPS在化学品生物合成方面的近期进展，并讨论了用于提升体系性能的关键工程策略，包括辅因子再生、途径平衡和半连续运行。此外，文章还重点介绍了将CFPS与人工智能指导的设计、可再生原料和模块化反应器技术相结合的新机遇，以推动更具可持续性且更易于规模化的生物制造过程。

sourceTitle: Chromosome-level genomics and cross-species enzyme screening enable high-titer bakuchiol production in Yarrowia lipolytica
sourceAbstract: The diversity of enzymes supporting bakuchiol biosynthesis remains incompletely characterized, limiting the repertoire available for microbial pathway engineering. Here, we combined chromosome-level genomics, cross-species enzyme screening and metabolic engineering to establish high-titer bakuchiol production in Yarrowia lipolytica. We assembled a 471.76-Mb Psoralea corylifolia genome anchored to 11 pseudochromosomes, with a contig N50 of 40.33 Mb. Genome-guided screening and functional validation identified four prenyltransferases from P. corylifolia and Vigna radiata whose N-terminally truncated variants supported bakuchiol production in yeast. These results extend experimental evidence for bakuchiol-producing activity across legume prenyltransferase sequences and species. For PcPT6, corresponding to the previously reported PcPT07, removing 40 N-terminal amino acids increased bakuchiol production by 53% relative to the full-length enzyme. We reconstructed bakuchiol biosynthesis in Y. lipolytica and reinforced aromatic precursor synthesis to increase p-coumaric acid supply. Coordinating mevalonate pathway reinforcement with increased t40PcPT6 gene dosage further improved bakuchiol production. Following fermentation optimization, titers reached 108.29 mg/L in shake flasks and 6.03 g/L in a 7.5-L fed-batch bioreactor. These findings connect an expanded set of functional prenyltransferases with coordinated pathway engineering, enabling gram-per-liter microbial bakuchiol production.
titleZh: 染色体水平基因组学与跨物种酶筛选助力解脂耶氏酵母高滴度生产补骨脂酚
abstractZh: 参与补骨脂酚生物合成的酶的多样性尚未得到完整表征，限制了可用于微生物途径工程的酶资源范围。本研究结合染色体水平基因组学、跨物种酶筛选和代谢工程，在解脂耶氏酵母（Yarrowia lipolytica）中建立了高滴度补骨脂酚生产体系。研究者组装了一个大小为471.76 Mb的补骨脂（Psoralea corylifolia）基因组，并将其锚定到11条伪染色体上，contig N50为40.33 Mb。通过基因组指导的筛选和功能验证，鉴定出来自补骨脂与绿豆（Vigna radiata）的4种异戊烯基转移酶，其N端截短变体能够支持酵母生产补骨脂酚。这些结果将具有补骨脂酚生产活性的实验证据拓展至更多豆科植物异戊烯基转移酶序列和物种。对于与此前报道的PcPT07相对应的PcPT6，去除N端40个氨基酸后，补骨脂酚产量相较全长酶提高了53%。研究者在解脂耶氏酵母中重建了补骨脂酚生物合成途径，并强化芳香族前体合成，以增加对香豆酸（p-coumaric acid）的供应。协同强化甲羟戊酸（MVA）途径并提高t40PcPT6基因剂量，进一步改善了补骨脂酚的生产。经过发酵优化，摇瓶中的补骨脂酚滴度达到108.29 mg/L，在7.5 L补料分批生物反应器中达到6.03 g/L。这些结果将拓展后的功能性异戊烯基转移酶资源与协同途径工程相结合，实现了克每升级别的微生物补骨脂酚生产。
